properties.name: A reflow2 server answers a request for its tool listing without naming a design, with no design's lessons in it
properties.source: flo2 design 1a97fc1f1de4d5d2, dec:a-tool-listing-needs-no-design, accepted by who:ajs 2026-10-25 ("Go with A")
properties.statement: A server that holds several designs answers a tool listing that names no design: every served tool with its schema and its base description, and no design's lessons appended. A listing that names a design keeps today's behaviour, with that design's lessons. A gateway in front of the server (flo2.io) can then describe its tools to a chat that has not yet chosen a design.
